purpose: Document that full creator-funding evidence acquisition remains a genuine programme requirement, formally separated from B2N, bound to the existing canonical B2Z contract, and NOT authorized by this or any prior B2N milestone.

architectural_chain.step_1: member is migration-lineage-qualified by B2N (BOUNDED_MIGRATION_LINEAGE_QUALIFICATION, this milestone)
architectural_chain.step_2: SEPARATE creator-funding stage (B2Z) may later run against migration-lineage-qualified members
architectural_chain.step_3: B2Z performs sequential 3-request evidence acquisition per member where required: getTransaction(migration_signature) -> getSignaturesForAddress(resolved_creator) -> getTransaction(candidate_funding_signature)
architectural_chain.sequential_dependency_confirmed: Each B2Z call depends on the prior call's response content (creator is derived from call 1; candidate funding signature is selected from call 2's results); this cannot be collapsed or parallelized, per direct code inspection of src/acquisition/b2z_execution_boundary.py resolve_creator() and B2ZRunner.run().

canonical_future_stage.name: B2Z
canonical_future_stage.reason: B2Z already exists in this repository as a named, tested, qualified contract (src/acquisition/b2z_execution_boundary.py, docs/evidence_platform/oip_v2_2e_2b2bq_b2z_run_preflight.json, docs/evidence_platform/oip_v2_2e_2b2bq_b2z_frozen_projection.json). No new B2CF milestone name is introduced; doing so would create a duplicate/parallel naming path for work that already has a canonical identity.

explicit_boundary_statements: B2N does not authorize B2Z execution.
B2N's request budget (max 20 total, max 1/member) cannot be borrowed, extended, or silently combined with B2Z's budget (max 60 total, max 3/member) for any run.

B2Z requires its OWN separate provider contract closure (a B2Z-specific P3-equivalent authorization preflight), distinct from this B2N-P3B artifact, even though both may end up naming Helius as the provider.
B2Z requires its OWN separate max-request budget: max 60 total, max 3/member, as already qualified in docs/evidence_platform/oip_v2_2e_2b2bq_b2z_run_preflight.json execution_contract.
B2Z requires its OWN separate ledger and run ID; B2N's attempt ledger and run ID (bound in this milestone) MUST NOT be reused or extended for a B2Z run.
B2Z requires its OWN separate explicit human GO/NO-GO. A GO on B2N's migration-lineage run does NOT constitute or imply authorization for a subsequent B2Z run.

Existing-operation mutation remains forbidden for B2Z exactly as it is forbidden for B2N: existing_operation_mutation_authority=false, merge/split/membership-write/attribution-write authority=false, WATCHTOWER_CANONICAL_STATE_MUTATION=FORBIDDEN.
Any B2Z findings involving an existing operation remain CANDIDATE_ONLY, exactly as B2N findings do.

authorization_status.note: This artifact is a documentation/boundary record only. It creates no executable authority for B2Z. A future, separately-authored B2Z-P3-equivalent authorization preflight (not part of this B2N milestone) would be required before any B2Z provider call could occur.
